title: Selected projects
description: Applications I have designed and built across web, microservices, mobile, desktop, AI, and DevOps.

items.title: Vithey / AUB Connect
items.description: A student superapp built for the ACLEDA Bank App Competition 2026, combining a Flutter mobile client with a Spring Cloud microservices backend and a FastAPI AI core. Covers a social feed, career tools with AI CV generation, student finance and fees, real-time chat, notifications, maps and an AI assistant, with Prometheus and Grafana monitoring.

items.title: LCS Freight Forwarding Platform
items.description: A modular-monolith freight forwarding, operations and double-entry finance platform. A statically generated Nuxt 4 frontend sits on a FastAPI backend with SQLAlchemy 2 and Alembic, backed by PostgreSQL, Redis and MinIO for attachments. Dashboard KPIs and report tables are served by dedicated reports endpoints rather than computed in the browser.

items.title: Pharmacy Stock Management
items.description: A modular FastAPI backend with authentication, brands, categories, administration and backup modules, paired with a Nuxt frontend using Nuxt UI, i18n and TanStack Table. Adds a Telegram bot, Excel and Google Sheets exports and PDF report generation, all deployed with Docker Compose.

items.title: MJ Stock Printing
items.description: A stock, printing and order management platform for a printing business. A FastAPI backend with Celery background jobs and Redis pairs with a Nuxt frontend for product catalogue, inventory and order handling, plus Telegram notifications and Excel and PDF report generation.

items.title: HollyWing Motor
items.description: Motorcycle rental management built as a Nuxt frontend and FastAPI backend on Docker Compose, with JWT authentication and role-based access. Ships a one-command Windows installer that clones the project, starts Docker Desktop, builds the containers, creates a desktop shortcut and registers a Task Scheduler logon task, so staff never touch the command line.

items.title: Traffic Analysis Desktop
items.description: A Windows desktop application for road traffic analysis built with PyQt6 and PyQt6-Fluent-Widgets. Computes AADT, PCU, ESAL and lane and road-classification metrics from raw counts, renders them with pyqtgraph and matplotlib, exports to Excel and PDF, and ships as a packaged executable via PyInstaller.

items.title: Campus Desktop Suite
items.description: A role-based school management desktop application built with PyQt6 and QML over an Oracle schema. Ships dedicated dashboards for students, teachers, parents and administrators covering attendance, classes, assignments, exams, results, library, payments and analytics, with an authentication and registration layer and a database test suite.

items.title: Course and Shop Platform
items.summary: React storefront with Django AI backend
items.description: A course and shop platform with a React frontend covering products, courses, enrollment and notifications, on a Django 4.2 REST backend with Celery, Redis and JWT authentication. Includes semantic search and a chatbot built with sentence-transformers and FAISS.

items.title: Employee Management System
items.summary: CRUD app on Docker and Kubernetes
items.description: A full-stack PHP 8.2 and Apache employee CRUD application on MySQL, containerised with Docker and orchestrated on Kubernetes via Minikube, then exposed publicly through a Cloudflare Tunnel and a DuckDNS domain. Uses a fixed NodePort so the public URL survives restarts and the demo stays reproducible.

items.title: Docetra
items.description: A document management platform with a Nuxt frontend built on TipTap for rich-text editing and Uppy for uploads, backed by a FastAPI service organised into organization, people access, records and storage-integration modules.

items.title: PDME Revenue
items.description: A revenue management platform covering data entry, exchange rates, audit logging and configurable data management, with dedicated FastAPI endpoints for analytics and dashboard KPIs. The Nuxt frontend provides internationalised reporting screens with chart-driven visuals.

items.title: Hanzi Learning v2
items.description: A rebuilt Chinese character learning platform with HanziWriter stroke animation, Noto Serif SC typography and Khmer font support, backed by a FastAPI and PostgreSQL API with JWT authentication and deployed behind nginx and Docker Compose.

items.title: Chinese Vocabulary Site
items.description: A statically generated Nuxt site for learning Chinese vocabulary, with HanziWriter stroke animation, per-book and per-word routes, Khmer and Simplified Chinese font support and a generated sitemap.

items.title: GDCE Local AI Chatbot
items.summary: AI chatbot running on LM Studio
items.description: A ChatGPT-style AI interface built with Nuxt, Vue, Vuetify and Tailwind CSS that proxies requests server-side to a local LM Studio model. Renders Markdown, Shiki-highlighted code, Mermaid diagrams and ECharts visualisations, sanitising output with DOMPurify and managing chat history with Pinia.

items.title: MiniDev
items.description: A responsive, fully prerendered product-suite website built with Nuxt 4, Nuxt UI, Tailwind CSS 4 and TypeScript, including a data-driven app grid, pricing toggle, help search and validated demo sign-up flows. Ships static output with security headers and HSTS, and adapts its Nitro preset for Vercel.

items.title: Document_IT
items.description: A Vue 3 and Vite portal for browsing documents and assignments, with Tailwind CSS styling, Vue Router navigation and Heroicons-based interface components.

items.title: School Management System
items.description: A full-stack school management system for managing students, courses, classes, enrollments, invoices, finance, and administrative operations. Built responsive mobile interfaces and organized reusable components, services, and application themes.

items.title: AI Chatbot and OCR System
items.description: An AI chatbot system with OCR functionality for extracting text from uploaded documents and images. FastAPI services connect the chatbot, the OCR pipeline, and the database, storing chatbot conversations and OCR results.

items.title: Django Storefront
items.description: An e-commerce application with product management, shopping workflows, and store operations built with Python and Django, containerized with Docker and backed by SQL.

items.title: PHP Marketplace
items.description: An e-commerce website to sell and manage products using PHP and MySQL, with SCSS-based styling and dynamic product pages.

items.title: Commerce Control Panel
items.description: An admin dashboard for e-commerce operations with product and order management, Pinia state handling, and Chart.js sales analytics.

items.title: Smart Parking Monitor
items.description: An IoT parking system with a Python backend, Vue dashboard, OCR plate recognition, and Wokwi hardware simulation for smart parking monitoring.

items.title: Vision Text Scanner
items.description: A Nuxt application for scanning images and extracting readable text with OCR, including PDF preview, data tables, and chart-driven reporting.

items.title: Campus Admin Suite
items.description: A school management platform for students, classes, and academic administration built with TypeScript and a responsive web interface.

items.title: Mobile Banking Wallet
items.description: A modern Cambodian mobile banking application with authentication, account management, transfers, bill payments, transaction history, card management, QR scanning, and exchange-rate features.

items.title: Hanzi Learning Studio
items.description: A Vue learning interface for Chinese characters with stroke animation via HanziWriter, progress charts, and a Python backend API.

items.title: GDCE Support Assistant
items.description: A Nuxt AI chatbot for GDCE support with Vuetify components, OIDC authentication, internationalization, and spreadsheet export.

items.title: GDCE Messenger
items.description: A Nuxt chat application for GDCE team communication with a Nitro server layer, typed API routes, and automated tests.

items.title: Record Manager
items.description: A Nuxt application for creating, reading, updating, and deleting structured records with Vuetify UI, CSV import, and chart reporting.

items.title: Dyna Workflow Desk
items.description: A Vue management system for organizing and tracking Dyna project workflows, with chart reporting plus PNG and ZIP export.

items.title: Wedcom Storefront
items.description: A Vue web project for Wedcom event and commerce presentation with routed pages and a responsive Tailwind layout.

items.title: Campus Course Portal
items.description: A React school website for shop and course information, with form handling, toast notifications, and performance tooling.

items.title: Angkor Digital Hub
items.description: A Nuxt content-driven hub for exploring local digital experiences, with multilingual routing, SQLite-backed content, and OG image generation.

items.title: Oracle Library Desk
items.description: A library management application for books, borrowing, and returns, built with Python and Oracle PL/SQL using an MVC structure.
